name: TR-286 transport
description: The TR-286 transport was a type of automated transport used in the galaxy during the Imperial Era. One TR-286, transport eight, was present on Daiyu and was used to ferry Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Princess Leia Organa to the mining planet Mapuzo. Many TR-286 transports were used on Epikonia to transport data-discs containing droid code updates to the surrounding sector.
